name: @tailuge/messaging
description: A stateful messaging library for Nchan-powered real-time applications.

scripts.playwright: npm run docker:build && npx playwright test --workers=1
scripts.playwright:rematch: npm run docker:build && npx playwright test playwright/lobby-rematch.spec.ts
scripts.playwright:e2e: npm run docker:build && npx playwright test playwright/e2e*.spec.ts --workers=1
scripts.playwright:new: npm run docker:build && npx playwright test playwright/iframee2e.spec.ts --workers=1
scripts.build:lit: npx esbuild src/client/lobby.js --bundle --minify --outfile=docker/html/lobby.js && npx esbuild src/client/tournament/tournament.js --bundle --minify --outfile=docker/html/tournament.js && npx esbuild src/client/tournament/arena.js --bundle --minify --outfile=docker/html/arena.js && rm -f docker/html/reveal.html docker/html/reveal.js && npx esbuild src/client/reveal/reveal.js --bundle --minify --outfile=docker/html/reveal/reveal.js && cp src/client/tournament/tournament.html src/client/tournament/arena.html docker/html/ && cp src/client/*.html src/client/manifest.json src/client/sw.js docker/html/ && rm -f docker/html/selector.html && cp src/client/reveal/index.html docker/html/reveal/index.html && mkdir -p docker/html/map && cp src/client/map/index.html docker/html/map/index.html && npx esbuild src/client/map/map.js --bundle --minify --outfile=docker/html/map/map.js && mkdir -p docker/html/challenge && cp src/client/challenge/index.html docker/html/challenge/index.html && npx esbuild src/client/challenge/challenge.js --bundle --minify --outfile=docker/html/challenge/challenge.js && cp src/client/favicon.ico src/client/robots.txt src/client/sitemap.xml docker/html/ 2>/dev/null || true && mkdir -p docker/html/assets && cp src/client/assets/*.png docker/html/assets/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.crossdeploy: npx esbuild src/client/lobby.js --bundle --minify --outfile=../billiards/dist/lobby.js && npx esbuild src/client/tournament/arena.js --bundle --minify --outfile=../billiards/dist/arena.js && rm -f ../billiards/dist/reveal.html ../billiards/dist/reveal.js && npx esbuild src/client/reveal/reveal.js --bundle --minify --outfile=../billiards/dist/reveal/reveal.js && cp src/client/lobby.html src/client/tournament/arena.html src/client/manifest.json src/client/sw.js ../billiards/dist/ && cp src/client/reveal/index.html ../billiards/dist/reveal/index.html && mkdir -p ../billiards/dist/map && cp src/client/map/index.html ../billiards/dist/map/index.html && npx esbuild src/client/map/map.js --bundle --minify --outfile=../billiards/dist/map/map.js && mkdir -p ../billiards/dist/challenge && cp src/client/challenge/index.html ../billiards/dist/challenge/index.html && npx esbuild src/client/challenge/challenge.js --bundle --minify --outfile=../billiards/dist/challenge/challenge.js && cp src/client/assets/*.png ../billiards/dist/assets/
scripts.crossdeployv: cp docker/html/lobby.js src/client/lobby.html src/client/manifest.json src/client/sw.js ../scoreboard/public/ && mkdir -p ../scoreboard/public/assets && cp src/client/assets/*.png ../scoreboard/public/assets/
scripts.build: tsc --declaration && node scripts/add-js-extensions.js && npx esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=docker/html/messaging.js && npm run build:lit
scripts.release: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && npm run build
scripts.build:all: npm run clientbump &&npm run build && npm run docker:start

author: tailuge
